description: The plot illustrates the relative change in the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model's performance as a result of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning with SnapKV as the pruning method. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer' and the y-axis is labeled 'Relative Change', with the baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit remaining constant at 0% across all layers. The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit) shows a steady trend, with a slight dip to approximately -5% at Layer13-20 before returning to 0%. The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) follows a similar pattern, dipping to -10% at Layer13-20 and recovering to 0% by Layer29-32. The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) starts at -2%, dips to -15% at Layer13-20, and rises back to -2% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) begins at -4%, drops sharply to -30% at Layer13-20, and recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. Overall, the LB-Avg methods demonstrate more stability compared to the RULER4k methods, which exhibit sharper declines at intermediate layers.
